title: Modular Library Update | Clo Feature Deep Dive
description:
Learn about the updates to our Modular Library with our Global UX Designer. Find out how these improvements work with older modular files and how the updates to saving your modular library can improve modular library sharing. 

Chapters:
1:13 Importing Old Files
2:22 User Setting
3:00 Saving Process
